data.description: A `Tensor`. Must have rank 1 or higher.

method.description: A `Tensor` of type `tf.string`. Fingerprint method used by this op. Currently, available method is `farmhash64`.

output.description: A two-dimensional `Tensor` of type `tf.uint8`. The first dimension equals to `data`'s first dimension, and the second dimension size depends on the fingerprint algorithm.
